friendly_name: Upgrade no-migrations provisioning fix + upgrade() tidy-first
purpose_context: Reinstated CI (#3995) exposed that spec-kitty upgrade hard-errors ('requires an existing authority') on the no-migrations/fresh-project path, leaving ~40 upgrade tests red. This mission makes the managed-skill provisioning guard non-fatal, re-evaluates each failing test against intended behavior (keep realistic heals, re-pin impossible fixtures), and first decomposes the ~345-line upgrade() entry point as a tidy-first enabler so the fix lands on a testable, un-suppressed surface. Scoped to issue #4032; true create-from-absent is deferred.
purpose_tldr: Stop spec-kitty upgrade erroring on fresh/no-migrations projects, and decompose the oversized upgrade entry point first.
